transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get this roundtable started. As we approach production lock on The Last Orchard presentation plan, I need our rights and music leads to report any confirmed changes before I can approve the final plan. Who would like to begin?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report confirmed changes from the rights side. I reviewed the revised license email from the Orchard Estate this morning. It permits exactly one public screening, requires 35mm projection, prohibits any audience or house recording, and requires the credit line 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate.' I should note I haven't uploaded the email to the shared production packet yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report confirmed changes from the music side. I received the signed musicians' agreement after the rehearsal plan was circulated. It requires a 14-player ensemble, and the conductor has approved only a 4:30 PM-5:30 PM rehearsal on October 18. I haven't yet added the agreement to the shared call sheet.
transcript.speaker: A3
